stem: Voltmarkt's stock is highest in November, before Black Week, and lowest in late December, after the holiday rush. An analyst uses the stock on 31 December as the average stock for the year's inventory turnover. What does this do?

options.text: Turnover looks higher than it is, as year-end stock is below the year's average
Turnover looks lower than it is, since year-end stock is above the year's average
Nothing changes, since any one day's stock is a fair stand-in for the year
Turnover becomes a measure of how long today's stock will last, in weeks
